bio.text: Karen Gonzalez Pittman represents District 65, part of Hillsborough County, in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Gonzalez Pittman was first elected in 2022.
Gonzalez Pittman is a business owner and educator who lives in Tampa, where Gonzalez Pittman was born.
Gonzalez Pittman studied elementary education and measurement, evaluation and testing at the University of South Florida.
